thread:
maya: Quick check — planning to roll SDK v31 (minor client-surface + new header) into us-east and eu-west tomorrow 02:00-04:00 PT. Who's owning the deploy, smoke, and rollback? Need client comms draft too. cc @tom @li @andrew

 tom: I can drive the deploy. Prefer staged canary: 5% -> 20% -> 100% over ~30m observation windows. Need someone on telemetry and on-call for the window. @jen-sre can you watch?

 jen-sre: I can watch telemetry. I'll monitor error-rate, p50/p95 latency, and token-cost delta. Alert criteria: >=3% error-rate increase or p50 +100ms sustained for 5m. Will post status updates in thread.

 li: Quick compatibility note — v31 adds optional header `X-Client-Compat: v31`. Older clients ignore it; server has a fallback path. We ran compatibility tests in staging (api-internal suite). Edge-case: very old SDK 2.x tokenization differences for some prompt edgecases — doc lists mitigation (suggest forced client bump to v30+ within 60 days).

 andrew: Deploy steps (high level):
```
# push canary
kubectl apply -f overlays/v31-canary.yaml --context=us-east-1a
# smoke (local)
./scripts/smoke.sh --target us-east-1a --concurrency 10 --duration 5m
```
Post-smoke: check traces in honeycomb (dataset: redwood.api.v31), and metrics dashboard (dash: SDK-v31-rollout). Rollback: flip feature flag `enable_v31=false` or revert canary images via `deployer rollback <id>` — I own rollback.

 deploy-bot: Reservation confirmed for 2026-03-18 02:00-04:00 PT, slot D-1034. Automated canary jobs scheduled.

 maya: Client comms — we need a short changelog blurb + migration note and a one-paragraph customer note for early adopters. Who drafts?

 tom: I'll draft the customer note and post a PR to marketing/docs in ~6h. Will include upgrade guidance and recommended rollout schedule.

 li: Please include the header fallback behavior and explicit curl examples: `curl -H "X-Client-Compat: v31" ...` and a snippet for older SDKs to set the header manually.

 jen-sre: Also add a quick smoke test that checks header paths: 1) request with header -> expect new codepath 2) request without header -> legacy path. I'll add assertions to smoke.sh.

 andrew: Rollback quick commands below (I'll keep these ready in the runbook):
```
# rollback to previous image
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/api-server api-server=redwood/api:v30.9
# flip flag if using feature flags
kubectl -n infra set configmap feature-flags --from-literal=enable_v31=false
# notify
curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"text":"Rollback executed: v31 -> v30.9"}' https://hooks.slack.com/services/T/rollout
```

 tom: Confirming owners: deploy = tom, rollback = andrew, telemetry = jen-sre, client comms draft = tom (with li on compat copy), cs notify = @customer-success. I'll add these to the rollout checklist doc.

 maya: Perfect. Can everyone ack readiness by EOD? I'll hold final go/no-go at 23:00 PT. If no blockers, proceed with scheduled window. :thumbsup:

 jen-sre: ack — will be on rotation for the window.

 li: ack — compat notes LGTM.

 andrew: ack — rollback hooks staged and tested in staging.

 tom: ack — drafting comms now, sharing PR in ~4-6h.

 maya: Thanks all — I'll ping @customer-success and schedule the release note once tom's draft is in. Keep this thread for status updates during the window.
